title: Yellowed Smoky Welsh Lamb Casserole
description: A hearty and smoky Welsh lamb casserole featuring mirin-hon and rest-meat, perfect for a low-calorie friendly meal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit
Season the lamb shoulder with smoked paprika and let it rest for 30 minutes
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes
Add the lamb broth, tomato paste, and mirin-hon to the pot and stir to combine
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven
Bake for 2.5 hours or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving
